section.title: pmMDA
section.p: The pmMDA - poor man Model Driven Architecture - is a framework to generate source code artifacts and the associated documentation following the MDA approach.
The development method is agile USDP using UML. The programming language is Java JDK-5.0. The license of the project is Apache Foundation License 2.0.

section.title: DOG and Explorer framework
section.p: The DOG provides powerful framework to implement mission critical applications. The data object graph DOG framework manipulates graphs of business objects. The explorer framework OEXdisplays and manipulates such graphs.
The development method is agile USDP using UML. The programming language is Java JDK-5.0. The license of the project is Apache Foundation License 2.0.
